outputs.explanation: Panels Ai-ii show a representative phase-contrast time-lapse of individual cells (mock-treated vs saccharin-treated) with no quantification, error bars, or statistics. No replicate count is stated for this panel, but none is required for a purely representative, non-quantified image series.

Panel B shows representative phase-contrast/fluorescence images of cells at different time points, with no quantification or statistical analysis. No replicate number is given, but this is acceptable since the panel is purely illustrative/representative.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
